title: Inlet Beach "Beach Smiles" 70 Emerald Cove Lane
h1: Inlet Beach "Beach Smiles" 70 Emerald Cove Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located steps from the beach- Amazing gulf views- Private Pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day**- Semi-Private beach access- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (Mar 1- Oct 31)- Standalone ice maker- Elevator- Grill- 5 adult bikes- Community pool- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Beach Smiles is a lovely 5–bedroom, 4.5–bathroom Inlet Beach–home with Gulf views that sleeps 16.Guests will love the convenience of a private pool, semi-private beach access, and gorgeous Gulf views from 2 oversized balconies.The first floor offers guests 2 bedrooms. A guest bedroom with a king bed shares a bathroom with a shower/tub combo with the second guest bedroom. This second guest room has a full bed and French doors that open onto a beautiful patio with a swimming pool. Guests will enjoy relaxing poolside on comfortable chaise loungers to the calming sounds of the pool's fountains, the constant Gulf breeze, and crashing waves.The main living areas on the second floor enjoy beautiful Gulf views. White shiplap and oyster shell chandeliers add a coastal feel to the large open kitchen, living, and dining area. Comfortable leather sofas and cozy armchairs invite conversation and are close enough to the generously sized marble-topped kitchen island that everyone can join in the fun. Next to the kitchen are French doors that open to a huge balcony. This outdoor living space is decked out with an outdoor grill and wet bar, a dining table, rocking Adirondack chairs, and an outdoor sofa. Guests will love the views of the Gulf while dining and relaxing in the shade.On the third floor, guests will enjoy the added privacy a living area (with a sleeping sofa) provides at the top of the stairs. A bunk room with bright white shiplap and cute dolphin and fish embellishments has 3 twin-over-twin bunk beds and a private bathroom with a shower. A guest bedroom has a king bed and French doors that open to a balcony with Adirondack chairs and Gulf views. This bedroom shares a bathroom with a shower/tub combo. A primary bedroom enjoys beautiful Gulf views from every window and has French doors which open to a balcony. The private bathroom has an oversized shower with a teak bench (and more Gulf views).Beach Smiles has everything you need for the perfect beach vacation. Enjoy exploring Inlet Beach, and nearby 30A on 5 included adult bikes. Beach Smiles won't last long with its location, Gulf views, and private pool.SLEEPING ARRANGMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Full Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyBunk Bedroom: Three Twin over Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Common Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboLiving Area: Queen Sleeper SofaUnfortunately, animals are not permitted in this home. Failure to adhere to this rule will result in immediate eviction and loss of deposit. Guest is fully responsible for all damages.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Inlet Beach "Beach Smiles" 70 Emerald Cove Lane Inlet Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-097676 Bedrooms 5 Beds 10 Sleeps 16 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located steps from the beach - Amazing gulf views - Private Pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day** - Semi-Private beach access - Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (Mar 1- Oct 31) - Standalone ice maker - Elevator - Grill - 5 adult bikes - Community pool - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Beach Smiles is a lovely 5–bedroom, 4.5–bathroom Inlet Beach–home with Gulf views that sleeps 16. Guests will love the convenience of a private pool, semi-private beach access, and gorgeous Gulf views from 2 oversized balconies. The first floor offers guests 2 bedrooms. A guest bedroom with a king bed shares a bathroom with a shower/tub combo with the second guest bedroom. This second guest room has a full bed and French doors that open onto a beautiful patio with a swimming pool. Guests will enjoy relaxing poolside on comfortable chaise loungers to the calming sounds of the pool's fountains, the constant Gulf breeze, and crashing waves. The main living areas on the second floor enjoy beautiful Gulf views. White shiplap and oyster shell chandeliers add a coastal feel to the large open kitchen, living, and dining area. Comfortable leather sofas and cozy armchairs invite conversation and are close enough to the generously sized marble-topped kitchen island that everyone can join in the fun. Next to the kitchen are French doors that open to a huge balcony. This outdoor living space is decked out with an outdoor grill and wet bar, a dining table, rocking Adirondack chairs, and an outdoor sofa. Guests will love the views of the Gulf while dining and relaxing in the shade. On the third floor, guests will enjoy the added privacy a living area (with a sleeping sofa) provides at the top of the stairs. A bunk room with bright white shiplap and cute dolphin and fish embellishments has 3 twin-over-twin bunk beds and a private bathroom with a shower. A guest bedroom has a king bed and French doors that open to a balcony with Adirondack chairs and Gulf views. This bedroom shares a bathroom with a shower/tub combo. A primary bedroom enjoys beautiful Gulf views from every window and has French doors which open to a balcony. The private bathroom has an oversized shower with a teak bench (and more Gulf views). Beach Smiles has everything you need for the perfect beach vacation. Enjoy exploring Inlet Beach, and nearby 30A on 5 included adult bikes. Beach Smiles won't last long with its location, Gulf views, and private pool. SLEEPING ARRANGMENTS: FIRST FLOOR: Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Guest Bedroom: Full Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo THIRD FLOOR: Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only Bunk Bedroom: Three Twin over Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Common Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa Unfortunately, animals are not permitted in this home. Failure to adhere to this rule will result in immediate eviction and loss of deposit. Guest is fully responsible for all damages.
